Corollary
[tubular neighborhoods]

Source: petersen:page-0207 ↗ def:pet-ch5-normal-exponential-map ↗ prop:pet-ch5-exp-diffeomorphism-properties 1. ch5:5.5.3$D\exp ^\perp $ is nonsingular at $0_p$ for all $p\in N$, and there is an open neighborhood $U$ of the zero section in $TN^\perp $ on which $\exp ^\perp $ is a diffeomorphism onto its image $\exp ^\perp (U)\subset M$, a tubular neighborhood of $N$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-tubular-neighborhood \sketch Restrict the block derivative $DE|_{(p,0_p)}=\begin{bmatrix} I & 0 \\*& I \end{bmatrix}$ from subsection 5.1 to $T_pN\oplus T_p^\perp N$. It remains nonsingular, so the inverse function theorem applies to $\exp ^\perp $ at every $0_p$. Proper embeddedness of $N$ allows these local inverses to patch over a neighborhood of the zero section.

□
